_note: Private gateway (this worktree, Claude as the model, REGISTRY_SEED_ENV=false, AVATAR_PREWARM_ON_CASE_START=true) and Lambda gpu_1x_a100_sxm4 (40 GB) workers it launched, 2026-10-22. Browser: Playwright Chromium with no proxy; TURN over TCP through scripts/turn_ws_tunnel.py (TURN over TLS on 443 could not be carried from this sandbox: Chromium's WebRTC resolves the TURN name with its own DNS, ignoring /etc/hosts and --host-resolver-rules, and the sandbox re-terminates outbound TLS). Voice click at case open (the worst case for the call's portrait) unless noted. Speech start = question sent to first audible patient sample in the page. Lip lag: positive = mouth after the voice; meter offsets with a score under 0.3 are not counted. probe_lag_ms: the runner's sync probe (corner block carrying each frame's audio loudness), end to end and independent of the portrait. Sender skew = video minus audio send-time offset measured by the runner per encoded frame.
